newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-DUTCH TOP THREE IN WINNING FORM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUTCH TOP THREE IN WINNING FORM.

text.p: Twente Enschede beat Volendam 4-0 in the Dutch league on Sunday with John Bosman and Paul Bosvelt each scoring twice.
The Twente victory means the top three places in the first division remain unchanged after a weekend which saw all the frontrunners win.

On Saturday, second-placed Feyenoord recorded their biggest home win of the season, beating lowly RKC Waalwijk 5-0, with a hat-trick by Gaston Taument, the first in his career, and goals from Henk Fraser and Tati Montoya.

Despite hammering RKC the gap between the Rotterdammers and league leaders PSV remained three points as the Eindhoven side won an uninspired game against Fortuna Sittard 1-0 through a Wim Jonk penalty.
PSV lead with 58 points from 25 matches, Twente are third with 52 points.
Ajax Amsterdam came from a goal behind for a convincing win over Roda JC Kerkrade 3-1 on Friday.
Melvin Plet shook up the Ajax defence in the fourth minute, hitting the net after a muffed clearance by goalkeeper Edwin van der Sar bounced off Roda striker Gerald Sibon.

But goals by former Roda player Tijjani Babangida and Mark Overmars, his first this season, in the first half and by Ronald de Boer in the second were the only positive returns from a dozen squandered chances.
Ajax, fourth overall, trail PSV by 16 points, but have a game in hand.
